en.title: Overnight Oats in a Jar
en.intro:
Make it before bed, and breakfast is ready in the morning!

Add a spoon of cocoa for chocolate oats.

steps.n1: Put the oats in the jar.
steps.n2: Add the milk, yogurt and honey.
steps.n3: Close the lid tight, then shake the jar hard!
steps.n4: Put it in the fridge overnight.
steps.n5: In the morning, slice the banana with a butter knife.
steps.n6: Top the oats with fruit and eat with a spoon!

legacySteps: Put the oats in the jar.
Add the milk, yogurt and honey.
Close the lid tight, then shake the jar hard!
Put it in the fridge overnight.
In the morning, slice the banana with a butter knife.
Top the oats with fruit and eat with a spoon!
